Solution A has the correct final answer, 26000.

Using the difference of squares, $513^2 - 487^2 = (513+487)(513-487) = 1000 \times 26 = 26000$.

Solution A applies this correctly. Its intermediate steps are unusual but valid: $513+487 = 1000$ and $513-487 = 26$.

Solution B uses the same factorization and gets $1000 \times 26$, but then makes an arithmetic error. $1000 \times 26 = 26000$, not 2600. Its "10 × 10 × 26 = 10 × 260 = 2600" step is wrong, since $10 \times 10 \times 26 = 2600$ is correct but equals $100 \times 26$, not $1000 \times 26$.

WINNER: A
